column_description: PRIMARY KEY (VARCHAR(20)) referencing actuation_data(ActReg). Ties maintenance/fault record to actuation data.
VARCHAR(25) storing a code for the specific fault (e.g., 'F1234').
VARCHAR(22) labeling the fault or issue category (e.g., 'Communication', 'Electrical', 'Mechanical', 'Software').
FLOAT(5) approximate float rating the probability or severity of fault.
VARCHAR(20) referencing the likely fault type (e.g., 'Motor', 'Joint', 'Gearbox', 'Controller').
INT storing Remaining Useful Life in hours if predicted.
SMALLINT capturing days until next scheduled maintenance is due.
DECIMAL(9,3) estimated cost for upcoming maintenance or repair.
